description.value: Sheringham Distillery is a small Vancouver Island craft distillery that won the world's largest gin competition and produces a range of award-winning gins, whisky, vodka, akvavit, and liqueurs. Visitors can explore the tasting room and sample spirits made with a chef-inspired, botanical-forward approach. The distillery production is rooted in Sooke using BC grain, with the tasting room located in Langford.
